ItemID: 1; Title: NEIKO 50432A Hex Nut Assortment Set | 150 Pc Nylon Locking Nuts | A3 Steel Hex Assorted Hardware Kit #10 & SAE | Metal Screw Nut for Bolts | Friction Lock Nut; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Could help with a hardware project, but I have no current need for these nut sizes.
ItemID: 2; Title: DEWALT Cutting Wheel, General Purpose Metal Cutting, 4-1/2-Inch, 5-Pack (DW8062B5), Multi; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not planning any metal cutting and have not established a need for grinder accessories.
ItemID: 3; Title: 1/2" x 2" Stainless Fender Washer, (100 Pack), 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel Flat Washer, 0.562" ID x 2" OD x 0.062" Thick, Plain Finish Metal Washer by Bolt Dropper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A hundred large washers is more than I need without a specific mounting job.
ItemID: 4; Title: Inkbird ITC-308 Digital Temperature Controller 2-Stage Outlet Thermostat Heating and Cooling Mode Carboy Homebrew Fermenter Greenhouse Terrarium 110V 10A 1100W; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Temperature measurement interests me, but I do not currently need to automate heating or cooling.
ItemID: 5; Title: Anderson Metals-06127-06 Brass Pipe Fitting, Barstock Street Tee, 3/8" Female Pipe x 3/8" Male Pipe x 3/8" Female Pipe; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no plumbing project requiring this particular fitting.
ItemID: 6; Title: NEIKO 01407A Electronic Digital Caliper Measuring Tool, 0 - 6 Inches Stainless Steel Construction with Large LCD Screen Quick Change Button for Inch Fraction Millimeter Conversions, Digital Caliper Measuring Tool; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for measuring small components and checking dimensions during electronics and mounting projects.
ItemID: 7; Title: Hillman 830606 Stainless Steel Fender Washers 3/16" x 1-1/4"; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These might suit a mounting task, but I would wait until I know the required dimensions.
ItemID: 8; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Potentially useful for repairs, but I do not have a repair right now that calls for permanent epoxy.
ItemID: 9; Title: SELTERM 25pcs 4 AWG 3/8" Stud Battery Lugs, Ring Terminals, Heavy Duty Copper Wire Lugs, Battery Cable Ends, 4 Guage Ring Terminal Connectors, UL Bare Copper Eyelets Electrical Battery Cable Lugs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These heavy battery cable terminals do not fit my small breadboard and low-voltage electronics work.
ItemID: 10; Title: Etekcity Infrared Thermometer Upgrade 774 (Not for Human) Temperature Gun Non-Contact Digital Lasergrip -58℉~ 716℉ (-50℃ ~ 380℃)with Adjustable Emissivity & Max Measure, Orange and Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in temperature tools, but I already have an Etekcity 1080 and would skip another similar thermometer.
